text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: between 9:06 and 10:06. Tumbling window: If our current time is 10:06,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the last 1 hour is the time between 9:00 and 10:00. conclusion: we solve

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) One thing that needs to be acknowledged in our High level design is that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: we have created index based on the view however from our kafka stream we

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: will have frequent updates to the view count hence frequent changes for the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: index. Right now every view leads to 1 row in the table. 2) CMS: Count - min

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Sketch How it works: say we have a videoId. CMS provides two methods -

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: add: uses a set of (n)hash functions increment value at n locaitons. -

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: estimate: using those same hash functions goes to those n locations and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: returns the minimum value from those n places.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Solution: For each window we maintain a list of k min heap/ sorted set that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: containtain the top k videos. a new video view comes in we use CMS to add

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and estimate. If the estimated value is larger than the minimum value from

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the heap or sorted set we remove it and add the new value else we do

g.text: 1) All the queries for top k are heading to DB. - Good solution: We can

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: reduce this by using a cache with certain TTL. We pick the TTL based on

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the eventual consistency of the view updates. Issues with current impl: For

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the cache hit everything is fine. For the case of cache miss we have huge

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: wait time which is not a great user excperience. - Great Solution: Cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: with precomputation, we use a cron job that adds data to the cache for

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: each window. Issue: What happens if the job fails.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Handling the massive amount of writes: 70B views / day => 700k qps -

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: We are using SQL db here. Hence we do sharding based on the video ids to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: read from the kafka. This sharding does increase the complexity for overall

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: computation of top k. We update the cron to fetch tok for each shard and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: then we merge the result. - we can further do batching of the views. In the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: solution the person has mentioned about using flink. we can look into it or

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: other aggregation solutions to take care of this.(1 hour based batching)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Optimizing the top k queries: Current flow for finding top K. : say our

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: window is T. For the given window we find the view count for each video in

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the given window then we take the aggregated view count and pull the top

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: K. - A good solution is to maintain aggregated tables for each window.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Hence it will be easier to fetch data from there.

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
